create_Session: create a Session instance with config, episode indices, and connection records for a HITL session
review_Session_init: review the Session class constructor to understand how episode indices and connection records are initialized
summarize_Session: summarize the Session class which tracks HITL session state including finished status and current episode

refactor_Session: refactor the Session class to add methods for advancing to the next episode in the session
